reddit.title: Improved Music Transitions in Provincia
reddit.body: We've made significant improvements to the way music transitions in Provincia. Instead of hard cuts, our audio now features smooth crossfades, enhancing your experience as you move through day, night, and combat scenarios. For more details, check out our latest devtalk here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/soft-music-reloops?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=soft-music-reloops
